brief.title: The brief
text: The studio covers weddings, first and eighteenth birthdays and christenings with its own photographers, videographers, drone operators and helpers, and every event needs the right people.
The app had to let the admin plan an event once and get the crew confirmed without chasing anyone.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built a Kotlin Multiplatform app with a shared module and native UI: SwiftUI on iOS and Jetpack Compose on Android.
Modelled events, users and finances in shared Kotlin, with kotlinx-serialization, kotlinx-datetime and moko-resources for Serbian and English.
Built the event flow: date, type of celebration, place, duration and the crew it needs, plus the staff the admin invites.
Sent invitations as FCM push notifications from a Firebase Cloud Function; staff accept or decline, and a declined offer goes to someone else.
Built the calendar, the event lists and a finance module that splits earnings between photographer, helper and drone operator.
